mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona City Hall and a temperature of 63 degrees. The moon is in a waxing gibbous phase, and if you are a night owl, look to the sky at 3:25 AM to see the space station travel from the direction of Mount Horeb toward Madison near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Police Department has released their summary of notable service calls between August 17 and August 24, including various traffic citations, drug investigations, and arrests reported throughout the city.

We have plenty of local activities on the calendar. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can join trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus there is live music at Paddy Mac's and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place.
On August 19, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive, where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations.

You can enjoy the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor of the day today, but keep in mind that the store is currently closed. They will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will be OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
